delete_confirm: Olongola likambo «{title}» elongo na lisolo na yango mobimba? Ekozonga lisusu te.
language_prompt: Olobaka mpe okomaka na lokota nini? Interface ekozala na lokota yango, mongongo na yo ekoyebana na lokota yango mpe mokambi akozongisela yo na lokota yango.
method_leads: Sikoyo lolenge ya kokanisa «{title}» nde ezali kokamba
method_done: «{title}» esili · longwa awa lisolo ya bonsomi
method_not_fit: «{title}» ekokaki te · longwa awa lisolo ya bonsomi
err_pending: Zela eyano liboso, to fina «Meka lisusu».
err_nothing_to_retry: Nsango moko te ezali kozela eyano.
err_no_voice: Mongongo ezali te mpo na lokota na yo.
err_not_voiced: Ekoki kotangama na mongongo te — meka lisusu.
err_internal: Likambo moko esalemi mabe — meka lisusu.
err_unknown_language: Lokota oyo ezali na liste te.
err_recording_rejected: Mongongo oyo okangaki endimami te — kanga lisusu.
err_speak_rejected: Makomi mpo na mongongo endimami te.
js_not_sent: Ekoki kotinda mongongo oyo okangaki te — meka lisusu; soki ekoki te, kota lisusu na onglet ya sika.
js_no_mic: Nzela ya kosalela mikro ezali te.
js_no_words: Liloba moko te eyokani — meka lisusu.
js_recording: Ezali kokanga mongongo… fina lisusu mpo na kotelemisa
js_talk_stopped: Lolenge ya lisolo etelemi — meka lisusu.
card.complexity-sensemaking: Likambo oyo ezali ya lolenge nini: polele, mpasi, mindondo to na moto
card.consider-opposite: Kanisa oyo ekeseni: likanisi ya mosusu na makasi na yango nyonso
card.customer-interviews: Tuna bakiliya na ntina ya oyo basalaki kala, kasi na ntina ya likanisi na yo te (The Mom Test)
card.demand-test: Meka posa ya bato liboso ya kotonga — likanisi na mituya mpe komeka ya ntalo moke koleka (pretotyping)
card.evaporating-cloud: Lipata oyo ezali kolimwa — kokakatana ya maponi mibale kozanga boyokani ya mabe
card.first-principles: Mibeko ya liboso: kabola tii na moboko mpe tonga lisusu sika
card.five-whys: Mbala mitano «mpo na nini» na bitape
card.goal-to-plan: Uta na mokano tii na matambe ya liboso: mokano, wapi nazali sikoyo, banzela, oyo nakosala
card.is-is-not: Ezali / ezali te: wapi mokakatano ezali mpe wapi ezali te
card.issue-tree: Nzete ya mokakatano: kabola likambo na bitape oyo ekangami te
card.jobs-to-be-done: Mpo na mosala nini «bazwi» yango — bokoli ya mokiliya mpe makasi oyo etindaka kobongola (JTBD)
card.offer-design: Oyo ozali kopesa: nini moto akozwa mpe mpo na nini akondima (Value Equation)
card.opportunity-tree: Nzete ya mabaku malamu, likanisi oyo ezali na likama koleka mpe makambo ya liboso
card.positioning: Esika na zando: bakokanisa yo na nini mpe ozali malamu koleka mpo na banani
card.pre-mortem: Pre-mortem — «kofungola ebembe» ya mwango oyo ebandi naino te
card.reflective-cycle: Kanisa makambo oyo ekomelaki yo mpe tala lisusu mobeko na yo moko
card.reversible-doors: Bikuke ya nzela moko to ya banzela mibale mpe 10/10/10
card.scamper: Banzela nsambo ya kobongola oyo ezali (SCAMPER)
card.socratic-questioning: Mituna ya Socrate: meka kondima na yo moko
card.traction-channels: Wapi kozwa bakiliya oyo bakoya: banzela mpe mimekano ya ntalo moke (Bullseye)
card.unit-economics: Mitango ya mbongo: nini mokiliya moko amemaka mpe ntalo na ye (LTV mpe CAC)
card.value-pricing: Ntalo kolanda motuya mpo na mokiliya (EVC)
card.weighted-matrix: Kokokanisa maponi na kilo kolanda makambo na yo ya motuya
card.wrap-decision: Ekateli ya mpasi — fungola, meka na makambo ya solo, mikabola mwa mosika, mibongisa (WRAP)
